# Code.org

> Code.org is a nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to computer science education in K-12 schools through free curricula, teacher training, and advocacy initiatives.

Code.org provides comprehensive computer science education resources across elementary, middle, and high school levels, supported by a network of regional partners and corporate collaborators. The organization combines free curricula, professional development, and policy advocacy to democratize CS education in the United States.

## About Code.org

- [About Us](http://mmarch.org/about.html): Code.org nonprofit mission, impact metrics, and diversity initiatives
- [How to help](http://mmarch.org/help.html): Donation options and ways to support Code.org's computer science mission
- [Newsroom](http://mmarch.org/news.html): Press kit, media inquiries, and brand assets for Code.org news

## Curricula & Learning Pathways

- [Elementary School Curricula](http://mmarch.org/elementary-school.html): K-5 free computer science curricula including fundamentals and AI
- [Middle School Curricula](http://mmarch.org/middle-school.html): Grades 6-8 CS Discoveries and maker education courses with AI
- [High School Curricula](http://mmarch.org/high-school.html): AP CS preparation including Principles and A with Java programming
- [Educational short videos](http://mmarch.org/videos.html): Educational videos on CS fundamentals, AI, cybersecurity, blockchain

## Teaching & Professional Development

- [Teach Computer Science](http://mmarch.org/teach.html): Computer science teaching resources, curriculum, and professional learning
- [Partner with us](http://mmarch.org/partner.html): Regional partner program for professional learning and implementation
- [Community and Support](http://mmarch.org/community.html): Teacher community, networking, and professional development support
- [CSTA-recommended 3rd Party Professional Development and Curricula](http://mmarch.org/3rd-party.html): CSTA-recommended third-party curricula and professional development

## Advocacy & Outreach

- [Promote Computer Science](http://mmarch.org/promote.html): CS advocacy, education policy, and state initiatives for K-12 schools
- [Inspire students](http://mmarch.org/inspire.html): Student inspiration through guest speakers and diversity outreach
